scope: Source map for two owned scenes; authoritative coordinates and primary layer/runtime decisions live only in each .scene.json.

scenes.producerReview: Original-RGB soft figure and source-pair contact shadow inspected on light/dark and corrected-pivot legal endpoints. Primary layer and runtime decisions live only in .scene.json; these independent captures do not constitute App runtime acceptance.

geometryEvidence.seatMeaning: Visible hip/cloth-to-cushion support contact, corrected after original-mother coordinate closeup and primary confirmation.
geometryEvidence.groundMeaning: Front complete loafer sole contact on floor; not a two-shoe midpoint or calculated center of mass.
geometryEvidence.frame: identity on original full canvas; figure/shadow pixels unchanged
geometryEvidence.legalEnds: u=-1 and u=1 fit current safeTextBoundary and canvas; same finite actor transform about authoritative corrected seat.
geometryEvidence.captureKind: Independent native SVG same-layer endpoint inspection, not an actual App Stage gesture/runtime acceptance.
